menus.note: Landlord September 9 release and October 8 official BOOKHOME note confirm December 4, 2026; current main site says early December without retracting that day. Host facility’s proposed 08:00–23:00 hours and pass prices are not the tenant’s service hours or a food discount. Shared common-area rendering accurately labelled; completed tenant gallery and exact branch dish/price roster remain unpublished. No other-branch menu, food photo or promotion borrowed. Operator’s own September 9 Kyoto release gives 17:00–23:00 and nine seats plus standing. Current crowdfunding details checked: supporter preview November 19 (planned)–December 3, separate from December 4 public opening; special birthday event November 18 is not normal service. Paper ticket and later assigned reservation required, no direct booking submitted. Alcohol-focused venue; crowdfunding excludes under-20 guests. Nonalcoholic alternatives are offered. Reward bundles include other benefits and platform fees; contribution amounts must not be presented as ordinary per-person menu prices. Individual sake labels, named snacks, live booking inventory and exact holiday closures remain gaps. Tokyo Nihonbashi photographs explicitly excluded.
